facts.business: Hitachi Energy India Limited provides power grid technologies, products, and integrated solutions for transmission, distribution, and automation, enabling grid infrastructure, renewable integration, and digitalization for utilities, transport, industries, and emerging segments like energy storage, data centers, and green hydrogen.

segments.name: Products, Projects and Services for Power Grids

capacity_or_capex.timeline: Announced October 7, 2024; cumulative capex of Rs 4,000 Crores

Supply chain resilience and risk management
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include royalty expenses of Rs 241.85 Crores to Hitachi Energy Ltd, purchases of goods/services from fellow subsidiaries (e.g., Hitachi Energy Sweden AB Rs 401.54 Cr payables), and dividend paid to holding company (Rs 19.07 Cr). Transactions are at arm's length and in ordinary course of business.
